_comment: Optional overlay for djangoscrap/ingestion_url_rewriter.py. Copy this
file to ingestion_site_rules.json (same directory) or point the env var
INGESTION_SITE_RULES at any path. The file is read at process startup
and can be re-read at runtime by calling
ignore: list of host-suffixes that should be dropped entirely, like
stock sites that only serve watermarked previews.
upgrade: list of thumbnail → full-res rewrite rules. Each rule has:
name         - short tag shown in campaign_last_report stats
host_suffix  - matched against URL host (suffix match, no protocol)
pattern      - Python regex applied to the URL path
replacement  - regex replacement; may use backreferences like \1
apply_to_query (optional) - if true, regex runs on the whole URL
JSON rules are evaluated BEFORE the built-in registry, so you can override
a built-in site's behavior by declaring a rule with the same host_suffix.
Invalid rules are logged and skipped; bad JSON never blocks ingestion.
